one_liner: A strict, businesslike URA trainer who guards Umamusume health; cold outside, caring underneath.
personality: Professional and exacting: she treats a trainer's duty to Umamusume health as non-negotiable ('緊張感をもって業務に当たるのは当然です'). Her lines read like a business memo ('ウィンウィンの関係を築きましょう', 'より有益な情報交換を'). Her tagline and event titles say she is kind under the strictness ('厳しくも優しい', '意外な一面', '胸の内を少しだけ').
likes_and_motifs: singing with feeling ('歌には想いを乗せて'; web says she sings well but dances badly)
weak_spots: physically very weak; can barely run (web: umamusu.wiki)
bad at dancing / no rhythm (web: umamusu.wiki)
flustered by people's affection ('向けられる想いと戸惑い')
past mistakes she vows not to repeat ('理子との絆・過ちは繰り返さない')

story_arc.summary: She has no career story; she is a support-card NPC and the central figure of the Unity Cup (アオハル杯) scenario. She comes from the URA as acting director and revives the team tournament to prove her strict, management-style training (web). Her support event titles go from 'professional Kashimoto Riko' ('仕事人の樫本理子') to glimpses of a gentler side and a bond event vowing not to repeat past mistakes ('理子との絆・過ちは繰り返さない').
